{{Quote|General Grayne. Been a while.''"<br />"''Hard to believe you and I started in the same squad. Still a ground-pounder, hmm?|Rusk and Grayne|<ref name="The Price of Victory" />}}
A '''squad''' in the [[Republic Army]] was active during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="The Price of Victory" /> Sometime after [[3665 BBY]],<ref name="Date">According to the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', [[Elin Garza]] enlisted at the age of 15 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] using false credentials, meaning that the minimum age for enlistment must be higher than 15. Therefore, as Fideltin Rusk did not enlist illegally, he must have been older than 15 at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the attack, and Rusk was born in [[3680 BBY]].</ref> the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Fideltin Rusk]] and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Callan Grayne]] were assigned to the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] upon enlisting in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. The two [[Republic trooper|troopers]] fought in the [[Geonosis campaign]] alongside the rest of the squad and other [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] such as the Human [[Durant]], and during his service in the squad, Grayne lost his entire left [[Limb/Legends|leg]]. Grayne received a [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic]] replacement and continued to serve, though both he and Rusk eventually moved onto to other divisions and greater responsibilities as the war progressed.<ref name="The Price of Victory" /> Later, during [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|2}}</ref> Grayne and Rusk reminisced about their [[Time/Legends|time]] in the squad.<ref name="The Price of Victory" />

==Behind the scenes==
The squad was first mentioned during a conversation with [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Rusk and [[General/Legends|General]] Grayne in "The Price of Victory," a mission for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="The Price of Victory" />
